source_note: IMPORTANT: this datalab folder is mislabeled -- despite the 'FY2024' folder name, its content is Mapletree Logistics Trust's 'Annual Report 2025/26' (fiscal year ended 31 March 2026), i.e. MLT's declared FY2025 under our Jan-Jun offset-reporter convention. Verified via in-document text: 'Annual Report 2025/26' (line 11) and 'FY25/26' section headers throughout (e.g. p49 'Divestments in FY25/26', p49 'Acquisition in FY25/26'). The differently-named parsed_reports/28_M44U.SI_Mapletree-Logistics-Trust_FY2025 folder actually contains the PRIOR year's 'Annual Report 2024/25' (FYE 31 Mar 2025) and was NOT used for this file.

transactions.sale_price_citation: p2280 'Divestments in FY25/26' table: '1 Genting Lane | Singapore | S$12.3 million | S$9.1 million | 13 May 2025'. Full-number verification: S$12.3 million = 12,300,000 (NOT 12,300).
transactions.citation: p49 'Divestments in FY25/26' table: Sale Price S$12.3 million, Valuation S$9.1 million, completed 13 May 2025. Footnote 1: independently valued by Knight Frank Pte. Ltd. as at 1 October 2024.
transactions.notes: DERIVED per explicit assignment instruction: the Divestments table on p49 has NO percentage-above/below-valuation column (only Sale Price / Valuation / Completion Date columns) -- pct_source is 'derived', never 'disclosed', for all six FY25/26 M44U divestments. Derived = (12,300,000-9,100,000)/9,100,000 = +35.16%. AR narrative (p681) states only a PORTFOLIO-level 'average premium of about 20% above valuation' for the six divestments combined -- not a per-property figure, so not usable as a disclosed per-property %.
